sections.heading: Safety checks before you pay
bullets: Book through the university or a known housing provider, not an unknown social media post.
Never pay a deposit for a room you have not seen on video or verified.
Get a written contract with the address, rent and deposit terms.

faq.q: Should I choose university halls or private housing?
faq.a: University halls are usually close to campus and easy to book from India. Private housing can cost less in some cities. We help you compare both for your university.
